prompt: In two sentences, explain how a seed becomes a tree to a curious adult.
ordinary: A seed starts as a tiny package with all the parts a tree needs, like food and a baby plant. When conditions are right, the seed cracks open, the baby plant grows up through the soil, and eventually becomes a full tree.
marked: A seed starts as a tiny, dormant package with all the parts a growing plant needs. When it gets water, sunlight, and the right soil, it sprouts a seedling, which grows taller and stronger over time, eventually becoming a full tree.
